title: DOSA atlas_replicons product line
description: One atlas_replicons JSONL line per replicon record (specification 0.1.0 section 11.2). Length, canonical/ambiguous base counts, and GC fraction are scientific observations produced only by the Sounio executable from the FASTA bytes; Julia independently recomputes them byte-exact. gc_fraction is (count G + count C) / canonical_count rendered with exactly six decimals, null when canonical_count is zero. input_sha256 is the orchestrator-computed SHA-256 of the exact FASTA file bytes the executable read, echoed by the executable into the line. Field order is fixed as listed in required and is enforced byte-exact by the differential validator.
